programme.title: TEAM TALKS - FRI 11 SEP
programme.desc: Punditry, pressers and predictions ahead of the PL Weekend. Our studio team tackle all the major talking points, and we hear from the headlines acts as the players and the managers have their say ahead of the action.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP2
programme.desc: Yaya Toure is widely regarded as one of the Premier League's most complete midfielders. He was at the peak of his powers in 2013/14, hitting 20 league goals en route to his second league title with Manchester City. The Ivorian shares his memories of the key matches and goals from that campaign.

programme.desc: We preview a blockbuster Manchester derby at Old Trafford as Michael Carrick faces Enzo Maresca, Newcastle's trip to Leeds and Spurs hosting Everton.
